signals.summary: Nanaya Shiki is stated to be Tohno Shiki's original name before taking the Tohno surname.

Across Tsukihime works, Nanaya Shiki may refer to childhood Shiki, Shiki under Nanaya demon-hunter blood agitation, Shiki's imagined killer side, or a relatively independent killer manifested by TATARI.
The source labels him another Shiki who calls himself Nanaya and has a killing tendency described as demon extermination.
In the original version, this appearance is described as Shiki's fear and unease about his inversion impulse reflected by Night of Wallachia and appearing as TATARI.

The source says dialogue implies Nanaya may use Mystic Eyes of Death Perception, while a later author comment says he does not have Mystic Eyes of Death Perception; this remains unresolved candidate-only evidence.
